staticText: Private NYSC service-period income and essential-cost ledger. The editable federal starting amount is source-dated; state, place-of-primary-assignment and other support are user-entered with separate paid-month counts. It calculates payer-period totals, remainder or shortfall, average income and a cash-buffer ratio without promising payment timing, arrears, payroll handling or eligibility. Users must verify every current amount and paid period with the responsible payer.
